name: Exponential Smoothing (SES / Holt / Holt-Winters / ETS)
when_to_use: Univariate time series; SES for constant level without trend/seasonality, Holt for trend, Holt-Winters/ETS for trend + seasonality.

expected_input.question: How to smooth and extrapolate a time series?

plain_explanation.purpose: Forecasts the future of a series over time, giving more weight to recent data.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there is a monthly or weekly series with trend and/or seasonality and you want a quick, simple forecast.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of values in time sequence, with regular dates; at least 2 complete cycles.
plain_explanation.example: Forecast sales for the next 6 months.
